About.

I'm a Computer Science graduate from BRAC University working where machine learning meets medicine. My research uses MRI scans, language, and large vision-language models to help detect dementia earlier.

Outside research I've led the R&D wing of the BRAC University Computer Club, built full-stack web platforms, designed graphics for youth organisations, and photographed the city I live in. I'm looking for a full-time role or internship where I can work on real AI systems and keep growing as an engineer.

Thesis.

Undergraduate research · 2025–26

A Multimodal Approach to Dementia Detection Using Contrastive Learning and LLM–VLM Assisted Reasoning with Guided Prompting

Supervised by Dr. Swakkhar Shatabda

INPUT

Multimodal patient data

Brain imaging paired with clinical and textual signals.

ENCODE

Modality encoders

Separate networks map each modality into a shared embedding space.

ALIGN

Contrastive learning

Matching pairs are pulled together and mismatched pairs pushed apart.

REASON

LLM–VLM with guided prompts

Language and vision-language models explain and support the prediction.

PyTorchContrastive learningVision-language modelsPrompt engineeringAI in healthcare
